state:Andhra Pradesh.text: The Andhra Pradesh government is actively positioning the state as a major hub for artificial intelligence through large-scale infrastructure investments, including massive hyperscale green AI data centers and partnerships with global tech firms like Google, Reliance, and Microsoft [R42588509, R1349768b, R06697b72]. The state has also approved specialized policy frameworks, established AI research and educational institutions such as dedicated AI universities, and integrated advanced curricula from school to higher education levels [R78ad8544, Ra4163b0a, R5237da05]. Furthermore, AI technologies are being deployed across public governance to improve citizen services, healthcare, urban disaster management, and revenue monitoring [Rd4cc8595, Ra460605d, R6e71a6d9, R1e515ffc].

state:Bihar.text: The Bihar government has actively advanced artificial intelligence adoption through significant investments, policy formulation, and high-profile partnerships with technology firms like Google and Microsoft [Rd71e810d, R57e2c2ec]. Notable initiatives include establishing the Bihar Artificial Intelligence Mission in collaboration with Singapore-based GFTN to train youth and support startups [R6fdc0aaa, Rb70e845b], as well as major infrastructural investments like a ₹10,000 crore data centre project by CtrlS [Rd3f465ac]. AI integration spans across diverse sectors such as school education and teacher training [Reb7bfdb3], healthcare service management [R79e87d3a], land-revenue tracking [Ra3ee576b], and public safety surveillance [R129aede2].

state:Gujarat.text: The Government of Gujarat has actively advanced artificial intelligence through infrastructure development, targeted governance applications, and educational initiatives. Key infrastructure efforts include the establishment of AI and data center clusters near GIFT City [Rb322fa47, R42b5efe9], a statewide GPU-as-a-Service framework [Rd1b68bba], and the Data Centre Policy 2026-29 aiming for Green AI capacity and mandatory renewable power integration [Re041bd74, R0d737a25, R43f4ae2b]. State governance is leveraging AI across sectors such as agricultural paddy quality testing [Re71562c3], dairy farming guidance via the Amul AI platform [Ra310e3fc], police surveillance challenges [R28ccc09b], and student dropout prevention [R88fee491]. Additionally, the state has initiated a major student training mission targeting 5 lakh students and thousands of faculty members [Ra6932da2], while the Gujarat High Court has concurrently enacted policies prohibiting AI use in judicial decision-making and judgment drafting [Rbd9766bd].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across governance, education, and infrastructure through various strategic initiatives and partnerships. The state government has advanced educational reforms by introducing AI as a vocational subject for middle and high school students, planning an AI university, and establishing multiple AI centres of excellence and labs [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6, Rb1015546, Rb77b1a7f]. Additionally, Karnataka has incorporated AI into public service delivery and administrative monitoring, launching tools like the KEO affordable AI computer for rural areas, AI-powered attendance tracking, and digital crop survey systems [Rd2e6b41c, Rf518fff6, R9d27904f]. Collaborative efforts with international technology leaders and global partnerships further underscore the state's drive to foster a competitive deep-tech and startup ecosystem [R223baf38, R65d60606, R4e7f795d].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through comprehensive policy approvals, significant infrastructure investments, and targeted governance frameworks [R562864e1, R03b6b6d6]. The state cabinet approved an AI policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore investment plan and established dedicated oversight committees and a new IT-AI department [R562864e1, Rd7d40f74, R5afedf9c]. Key initiatives span multiple sectors, including the deployment of 'Maha AI' for governance, Sarvam AI tools for government operations, and partnerships with technology firms for green data centres and AI innovation hubs [R68fee1a0, Re0b416d1, R03b6b6d6]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI into public services, policing, education, and agriculture through specialized platforms and pilot projects [R04592b70, R44b25a30, Rcd594eaf].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public administration, governance, and infrastructure development, highlighted by initiatives like the 'Ama Sathi' WhatsApp chatbot and AI-enabled traffic and security systems [Rabdf8555, R8a2dd09f, R499f4234]. The state is also driving major economic investments in tech infrastructure, including partnerships with Sarvam AI to establish sovereign compute capacity, semiconductor packaging, and large-scale AI data centers [R230b6e3b, R69c4b40c, R3a36bb44]. Furthermore, Odisha is reforming its educational sector by introducing AI courses, robotics labs, and curriculum updates from school to university levels [Rdb5da3c5, Rf1f957f6, Re8e26306].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued widespread integration of artificial intelligence across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state education system introduced AI as a core and mainstream curriculum subject in government schools for classes ranging from Class I to XII [Rf6319e99, Re45fa955, R5c2eec42]. Concurrently, law enforcement agencies deployed AI-powered tools, voice recognition systems, and smart command centers in partnership with IIT Ropar to track criminals and dismantle organized crime [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, Re289fcd5]. State initiatives also leveraged AI for agricultural advisory services, healthcare screening, and infrastructure monitoring [R609b6fc5, Ree614b14, R4e4970c3].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has aggressively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure developments, including partnerships for a Sovereign AI Park and an AI-ready data center campus [R472c3c1a, R70cb396d]. The state government has integrated AI into public service delivery and governance by launching WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' for healthcare and administrative functions [R576baa19, Re58fb67d]. Furthermore, educational initiatives such as the TN SPARK program and teacher training via SCERT are actively introducing AI tools into government schools [R9cd35018, Rfe24cede]. Conservation efforts have also benefited significantly, with AI-based early warning systems successfully preventing elephant fatalities along railway tracks [Rc2b44680, R31409be3].

state:Telangana.text: The state of Telangana has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across infrastructure, governance, and public services, highlighted by major data center investments and the development of specialized hubs like the AI City and Telangana AI Innovation Hub [Ra0d04f11, Rfd882f23, Rafe9a4a2]. Government initiatives extensively leverage AI for public welfare and administrative efficiency, spanning agriculture advisory tools, tax leakage detection, digital public infrastructure via TGDeX, and stringent automated traffic and driving test systems [R45e372bd, R849548ed, R389847d5, R4ac51e57]. Furthermore, law enforcement and public safety have been modernized through AI-driven policing initiatives, emergency response upgrades, and specialized investigative assistants like Police GPT [Ra1409382, R867da268, R9e549a99]. The state has also prioritized large-scale capacity building by launching expansive AI literacy and technical skilling programs for millions of students in partnership with tech giants [R6843cc3b, R3bfd0d73, R89c590e8].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: The Uttar Pradesh government has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration through large-scale infrastructure investments, including the planned AI City in Lucknow and a robotics and AI park in Greater Noida [R3cf60d9f, Rb1cbd4df]. Major Memorandums of Understanding have been signed with firms like TryfactaConnex and the AM Group to establish gigawatt-scale AI data compute hubs and data center capacity [R212c0bcb, R6af01bf4]. The state cabinet approved the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission and a Data Centre Policy to support tech governance, startups, and infrastructure expansion [Rb312992b, R398131aa]. Furthermore, workforce development and public service delivery are being prioritized via mandatory vocational AI courses, youth training partnerships with companies like IBM and Oracle, and AI deployments in road safety, health, and crime tracking [Re48eb24d, R1e320eca, Ra6233201, R10e7268a, Rc6148c8c].

category:strategy_policy.text: Multiple Indian states have formulated comprehensive AI policies, missions, and infrastructure initiatives to drive regional technology growth and digital governance. For instance, Maharashtra approved an AI Policy with a planned investment of ₹10,000 crore [R562864e1], while Chhattisgarh launched a ₹500 crore AI Mission focused on skills, digital economy, and governance [R7cc53f61]. States are also prioritizing large-scale digital infrastructure and specialized technology hubs, such as Uttar Pradesh's Data Centre Policy targeting ₹2 lakh crore in investments [R398131aa] and Gujarat's Data Center Policy targeting 7.5 GW of Green AI capacity [R43f4ae2b]. Additionally, several administrations have integrated AI skilling and educational reforms, including plans for AI training programs for students and youth across Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Gujarat [R4af400f2, Ra6932da2, Rb312992b].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and high courts have actively established regulatory frameworks and restrictions concerning the deployment of artificial intelligence in judicial and administrative processes. Notably, the Gujarat and the Punjab and Haryana High Courts implemented policies prohibiting the use of AI tools in decision-making, judgment drafting, or issuing legal notices, following instances involving AI-generated non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30, R8eacd504, R3d477cff]. States have also focused on safeguarding data privacy and mitigating risks associated with deepfakes and synthetic content through departmental circulars and advisory measures [R607d069a, Rc7b7e0d9, Re078b4dc]. Additionally, several states are formulating comprehensive responsible AI policies, safety protocols, and frameworks for data governance to oversee ethical adoption [R9b3c768e, Raf4f7b8d, Rdff5f567]. Committees and panels were further established to draft standard operating procedures for emerging technologies such as wearable AI devices and automated monitoring systems [Rba8badb1, R40c3cafc].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments have actively driven funding and budget allocation toward artificial intelligence infrastructure, missions, and sector-specific initiatives. Major commitments include large-scale data center investments and multi-crore state AI missions, such as Chhattisgarh's Rs 500 crore AI Mission and Uttar Pradesh's Rs 2,000 crore AI allocation [R7cc53f61, R297b1b1d]. States have also dedicated substantial outlays to specialized projects like Maharashtra's Rs 500 crore MahaAgri-AI Policy and Haryana's Rs 474 crore AI Development Project [R5c8784f8, R56704031]. Additionally, several states have secured massive private sector investment proposals and signed high-value MoUs for computing and digital infrastructure [R44971ae6, R2269e1a7].

category:infrastructure.text: State governments across India are aggressively expanding their digital and artificial intelligence infrastructure through large-scale investments in data centres, AI cities, and specialized compute hubs [R31b27cb7, R42588509, R398131aa]. Major projects include massive gigawatt-scale data centre campuses, sovereign AI parks, and robotics hubs announced or approved in states such as Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha, and Maharashtra [R5b4a7a80, R472c3c1a, Rf8ceda95, R657bba09, R3eefbde9]. Additionally, states are establishing targeted educational and technological facilities like AI universities, Centres of Excellence, and GPU infrastructure frameworks to foster regional deep-tech ecosystems [Rc16dddf8, R6ae1aafc, Re78dfed2, Rd1b68bba].

category:partnership.text: State governments across India have actively pursued partnerships, MoUs, and high-value investments with technology giants and research institutions to accelerate artificial intelligence adoption [R44971ae6, R84a7e58c]. Major focal points include infrastructure development, highlighted by substantial commitments for hyperscale AI data centers and computing hubs in states such as Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Gujarat [R5b4a7a80, R42588509, Re0b416d1, Reff5d158]. Additionally, numerous states have collaborated with industry leaders like Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic to establish centers of excellence, integrate AI into governance, and enhance public service delivery [R65d60606, R2889d124, R998e03d5]. Education and workforce skilling also feature prominently in these agreements, with multiple regions partnering with firms to train teachers, students, and youth in artificial intelligence capabilities [Reb7bfdb3, R3bfd0d73, Rf3ab0e70].

category:deployment.text: State governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across public services, governance, and infrastructure, with a strong focus on WhatsApp-based citizen engagement tools and regional language translation platforms [Rabdf8555, Rad868781, R576baa19]. Significant initiatives also include the integration of AI for enhanced security, law enforcement, and administrative monitoring such as automated exam surveillance, traffic management, and cybercrime investigations [R04592b70, Re0c4ff32, R7333c0ad]. Furthermore, states are launching specialized hardware and localized educational tools, including affordable AI-ready computers and AI-powered learning programs in schools [R3590a0eb, R27258895].

category:skilling.text: Indian state governments have launched extensive AI skilling and educational initiatives, introducing curricula and teacher training programs across schools and higher education institutions. Notable actions include Punjab making AI a mainstream subject for Classes 1 to 12 [Rf6319e99], Karnataka introducing AI from Class 6 alongside plans for a public AI university [R8176ca19, Rb77b1a7f], and various states partnering with major tech firms like Google and Microsoft to train teachers and youth [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306, R06697b72]. States such as Uttar Pradesh and Bihar have established dedicated AI missions and large-scale training schemes targeting millions of youth [Rb312992b, R1a841461, Rb70e845b]. Additionally, regional programs focus on specialized demographics, including AI bootcamps for rural and tribal youth in Jharkhand and AI-enabled learning for tribal students in Chhattisgarh [R19745493, R8ae280e0].

category:events_outreach.text: Indian state governments have actively engaged in AI outreach through numerous summits, conferences, and expos aimed at boosting digital governance, investments, and regional innovation [R84a7e58c, Re9890866, Reb9a8d36]. Significant events include major gatherings like the Bengaluru Tech Summit and various regional AI impact conferences hosted by states such as Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, and Odisha [R4348031c, Rc3b838b, Reb9a8d36]. Additionally, several states have driven student and developer engagement through targeted hackathons, boot camps, and workshops focused on domains like agriculture, policing, and healthcare [Rc7e57d12, Rb8c534c6, R28ccc09b].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, deploying AI cameras for traffic monitoring and public safety alongside judicial tools like mandatory transcription systems [R6d538903, Rf2c35456]. The state government has also focused heavily on education and administration by launching teacher training programs, student robotics initiatives, and administrative governance overhauls [Rc3656b09, R3db21292, R8f4114ad]. Furthermore, Kerala is actively positioning itself as an emerging technology hub through the establishment of twin AI Centres of Excellence, startup funds, and substantial data centre investments [Raa18758, Re3333cd0, Ra525c46d].

category:governance_body.text: Several Indian states have established dedicated governance bodies, ministries, and specialized task forces to institutionalize artificial intelligence in public administration. Kerala and Tamil Nadu introduced dedicated AI portfolios and ministries [R6bbe2d82, Ref475c84], while states like Maharashtra, Gujarat, Haryana, and Karnataka formed high-level committees, policy task forces, and specialized AI cells to oversee ethical frameworks, police modernization, and administrative reforms [R9b3c768e, R5afedf9c, Ra6b5d331, Re88286cf]. Additionally, departments focusing on information technology and future technologies have been rebranded or newly created in states like Kerala and Maharashtra to drive comprehensive digital transformation and AI integration across sectors [Ref58a154, R6f0677ec].

overall.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued artificial intelligence policies, infrastructure investments, and educational initiatives since November 2022. Multiple states like Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Bihar have formally approved or proposed comprehensive AI policies alongside substantial financial investments and infrastructure projects such as AI cities, sovereign AI parks, and data center hubs [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rc68da9b5]. Furthermore, states have integrated AI into public services, policing, and governance through initiatives like AI-enabled tracking portals, cybercrime copintos, and automated administrative systems [Rd731fc75, R04592b70, Rb7cd9ee5]. Educational transformations are also widespread, with various states launching school-level AI learning programs, teacher capacity-building, and specialized digital skill development boot camps [Rf6319e99, R27258895, Rc119f335].

state:Assam.text: Assam has actively pursued an AI-driven transformation across governance, education, healthcare, and infrastructure, mapping hundreds of proposals and commissioning a government-owned GPU cluster to power state services [R936eb0aa, R416e5d33]. Key initiatives include deploying artificial intelligence for flood rescue via WhatsApp, forest encroachment and deforestation monitoring, and wildlife protection through automated train collision alerts and monitoring systems [Rc2490b65, R9c52da90, R037e76ac, Rddd6a227, R692a244d]. The state has also integrated AI tools into schools and teacher training programs in partnership with Google and UNICEF, alongside introducing AI anchors and administrative systems like 'ALISA' [R5a187c0b, R39b50ddb, Re167bad2, R68e89c81].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is actively advancing its digital transformation through the Rs 500 crore Chhattisgarh AI Mission, focusing on infrastructure development, governance, and large-scale skill initiatives [R7cc53f61, Ra8b92ce6]. Significant infrastructure projects include the establishment of an AI-based data center park in Nava Raipur, backed by substantial corporate investments [Rcc6c8e84, Rd28b546d, R28218dab]. The state has also integrated artificial intelligence into education and public safety, deploying AI-enabled learning campaigns with Google for teachers, tech training for tribal students, and AI surveillance and tracking systems for wildlife conservation and policing [R398fad0d, R1445ea1e, R96ea213d, R71e1d0ae].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has actively pursued digital transformation and governance initiatives by integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors such as education, policing, and agriculture [R127f881c, R4f453e9d, Ra6b5d331]. Major infrastructure and development projects, including a multi-crore partnership with the World Bank and plans for specialized AI hubs in Gurugram and Panchkula, form the cornerstone of the state's technology roadmap [R56704031, R2fc878d0]. The government has also introduced targeted AI tools and chatbots to enhance public service delivery, modernize police operations against cybercrime, and update educational curricula in schools and industrial training institutes [R4f453e9d, Re984ab2a, Reb76be7f].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh has actively integrated artificial intelligence across education, governance, healthcare, and environmental management [Re82f2564]. In the education sector, initiatives range from launching digital platforms like the 'Padhai with AI' app and the Vidhya Samiksha Kendra to introducing AI, data science, and drone technology courses in schools and higher education [Rb23a865a, R39cd627c, Rbc10366f, Rc9d96f12]. Governance and public services are being transformed through AI-based document verification on portals, fraud detection in health schemes, and advanced disaster risk and forest intelligence systems [R38e56e62, Rc3a3d3b4, R26835c79, Rc1ad1a5c]. Additionally, the state has advanced healthcare with robotic-assisted surgery facilities and partnered with institutions like IIT Mandi for forensic and safety mapping tools [R19aa9a66, Reb98bbcd, Rc06b19cc].

state:Jharkhand.text: The government of Jharkhand has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across multiple sectors, anchored by the draft Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Vision 2050 roadmap aimed at driving investments, governance, and job creation [R7694c76a, R927ec078]. Major developments include infrastructure projects like a data centre and AI tools for the High Court, mandatory AI use for quality control in infrastructure, and specialized AI monitoring tools for public safety, healthcare tracking, and wildlife management [Re675872a, Rde702427, Rb7cd9ee5, Rd53d5e43]. Additionally, the state is expanding educational and training programs through new AI labs, school smart classes, and centers of excellence to build a skilled workforce [R8022329a, R95bbe8d6, R86310780].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh has increasingly integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public services, law enforcement, and economic development initiatives [R6473839f]. The state government partnered with Google Cloud to drive AI-powered governance and utilized AI analytics to detect financial anomalies and irregularities in urban civic purchases and procurement [R9069faa1, R6473839f, R4c96f220]. In law enforcement and public safety, authorities deployed AI surveillance systems like 'Trinetra' for crowd and temple management, established AI monitoring towers to curb illegal sand mining, and incorporated AI tools into police training and operations [R085470af, R80dec475, Ra365ac4c]. Additionally, the state has promoted technological infrastructure and education through initiatives such as planning AI data centers, advancing semiconductor and chip packaging investments, and launching AI training programs for educators and students [Rd5bd5d63, R4df0843d, R5d3f24d3].

state:Manipur.text: Manipur has integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, legal proceedings, and conservation efforts since late 2022. Significant actions include the Manipur High Court using ChatGPT for legal research and delivering a landmark verdict [Rc647f8ab, R647a600d, Rdb89b488], and partnerships with Microsoft and the BHASHINI Division to advance multilingual AI and digital governance [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. The state has also promoted AI in classrooms and academic research, launched an AI career guidance hub, and explored AI applications for wildlife trafficking and tribal development [Rbb7d36a7, R7249ca9d, Re9f95033, R13590541]. Additionally, initiatives span digital tourism, journalism workshops, and language translation tools like the app 'Ishaan' [R49d826c3, R3413274d, R0ffcf77b].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, public health, and environmental management, as highlighted during the Regional AI Impact Conference [Radc3741c, Rb3735138]. Key initiatives feature AI-powered solutions for waste management at Umiam Lake [Rac5495f0, Rdb44e226], public health improvements that have reduced maternal mortality [R84a1eeb7], and partnerships with Wadhwani AI to support agriculture and education [Rf1f88f85, R4d3283aa]. The state is also expanding its tech ecosystem by drafting a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres [R9625f972], proposing an AI Centre of Excellence [Rf277c3a3], and incorporating AI and robotics into school curricula and learning programs [R24be49c9, R7a03a9ec, R5aa6ef3e].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has positioned itself as an active participant in artificial intelligence adoption, initiating a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a regional technology ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state government has integrated AI across multiple sectors, including deploying AI tools for tax enforcement, agricultural missions, police traffic management, and healthcare infrastructure [Ra65da593, R2235629e, R8edb04a8, R2748f23d]. Additionally, Tripura has focused heavily on education and digital inclusion by launching AI skill initiatives, free courses for students, and translation services via the BHASHINI initiative [R3fff65a8, R12023632, R2f53bb22].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, education, and environmental management by hosting major events like the Devbhoomi AI Summit and implementing AI-driven curricula in higher education institutions [R8a719696, Rcea6d545]. The state government has integrated AI technologies into public services and security, deploying AI tools for forest and wildlife conservation, cyber fraud helplines, revenue mechanisms, and civil infrastructure monitoring [Recb1f69d, Rfadf7808, R549f779d, Rf32d6d42]. Additionally, specialized AI applications have been launched to preserve regional languages, enhance disaster forecasting, and secure public examinations and pilgrimage routes [R3158dd4a, Rca18ab02, R9dac4ef2, Rca2abc09].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively advancing artificial intelligence integration across industrial, administrative, and educational sectors, anchored by a draft industrial policy and the West Bengal AI Mission focusing on infrastructure, data centres, and MSMEs [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5]. Governance and public safety initiatives include the formation of a dedicated West Bengal Police AI Cell, an MoU with Rashtriya Raksha University for AI surveillance training, and the deployment of AI-powered applications for investigations, missing persons, and civic service management [Re268e526, R5118fef0, R08e415eb, Rebcdd9ec, R1e4db06d]. Educational reforms feature the introduction of AI, data science, and coding curricula across schools and higher secondary boards, alongside training partnerships with Oracle to upskill thousands of students [Rf61a82a3, Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1, R6da26467, R0c4d9eef].

state:Rajasthan.text: Rajasthan has integrated artificial intelligence across numerous sectors through strategic policies and institutional partnerships, notably approving the AI-ML Policy 2026 and launching foundational training courses for citizens [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. Key administrative applications include AI-powered traffic management, automated surveillance, utilities monitoring to curb power and water theft, and enhanced public grievance redressal via platforms like Rajasthan Sampark [R9fa136c5, Rc7b7e0d9, Rc030208, Rcaf01e51]. Furthermore, the state has advanced AI adoption in agriculture through collaborations with Wadhwani AI, healthcare diagnostics, and wildlife conservation efforts such as AI-assisted breeding and monitoring [R6de84b70, Re21823b6, Re141ed2f].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, agriculture, and public services, highlighted by the launch of an AI-powered digital agriculture ecosystem and the Eliona AI Supercomputer for disaster preparedness [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812]. The state has also integrated AI into law enforcement and local administration, deploying number plate reading cameras for the police and winning a National e-Governance award for a district WhatsApp chatbot [R17676278, Rb26a6b87]. Education and skilling are major focal points, featuring the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence, faculty development workshops, and plans to introduce an AI curriculum starting from Class 6 [R6f55ee54, Ree819f7b, R8b9ea930].

state:Sikkim.text: Sikkim has actively integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, most notably deploying an AI-driven Traffic Management System and e-challan mechanisms to enhance road safety and manage traffic congestion [Re7e20a6f, R24fc93a2, Ref56657c]. In education and agriculture, the state has launched AI-powered learning programs in government schools, partnered with NIELIT Gangtok to establish an AI Centre of Excellence, and pilot-tested an AI-enabled WhatsApp chatbot to support farmers [R27258895, Red4520ff, R2569fc2d]. Additionally, the government has advanced technology adoption by introducing an AI-based permit system to boost tourism and discussing AI applications for disaster prediction and higher education partnerships [Rfc6c0173, Rb685bb8f, R604d927c].
